jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for a cute polished hand-painted storybook town game. The reference is STYLE ONLY. Bottom row is a medium-height muscular middle-aged seaside botanist with LONG THICK BRAIDS, round collar and puffed sleeves, teal short jacket, trousers, botanical specimen notebook. Every cell shows the entire head, body and feet; absolutely no clipping. Row 1 columns 1-4 WALK: left foot forward, feet passing, right foot forward, feet passing; columns 5-8 ACTION: lifts lemonade pitcher, tilts to pour into glass, fills glass, offers glass. Row 2 columns 1-4 the same full-body walk sequence; columns 5-8 ACTION: opens notebook, studies a seaweed specimen in hand, writes a note, closes notebook. Same identity and scale across each row; three-quarter elevated view facing right. Clear changes in leg position for the walk, clear arm motion for the actions. No counters or scenery. Generous 15 percent clear transparent gutters between cells, full head and shoes in all SIXTEEN cells. No text, no lines, no floor, no shadows. Crisp beautifully painted miniature illustration with soft dark outlines.
